name: @gofastr/logstream-term-bundle
description: In-frame terminal bundle for the GoFastr logstream plugin. Builds a single IIFE (xterm.js + search/fit addons) that runs inside the opaque-origin sandboxed iframe and speaks protocol v1 to the host over postMessage: the host PUSHES streamBatch events unasked, the frame renders one batch per animation frame and acknowledges with streamAck — the ack window is the bridge's backpressure.
